span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THREE TESTS IN SEQUENCE, EACH ASKING A DIFFERENT QUESTION: a Kruskal-Wallis rank test for whether the feature differs at all, pairwise Wilcoxon tests among SUBCLASSES for whether the difference is consistent with the population structure, and LDA for how big it is
span.note: about this quote: the quote carries a line-break hyphen scar: the paper's “Kruskal-Wallis” is staged as “Kruskal- Wallis”. Verbatim against the staged text; the damage is mid-name and cannot be re-sliced around. Confidence 0.85 under Q-606.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: EXPLAINING RATHER THAN DETECTING: the method keeps features able to explain the difference between conditions, not merely those with uneven distributions - which is what a significance test alone returns
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: PRIOR KNOWLEDGE AS A CONSTRAINT ON A HIGH-DIMENSIONAL SEARCH: the biological hypothesis is encoded and used to narrow the space, which is the paper's answer to having far more candidate biomarkers than samples
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE TRADE IS STATED AND PRICED: a substantially better false positive rate is bought with a moderately increased false negative rate, and the paper says the user can adjust where it sits

span.label: There are typically far more candidate biomarkers than samples, which is a property of the data and not of the method
